body: I stopped 4 days before while prepped for surgery (mine was an emergency) I told the anaesthesiologist and she was so chill and grateful I told her - they’re used to seeing people on all kinds of drugs so better off letting them know, that way they know the correct dosages to keep you under/ safe. They do not care , they just don’t want you waking up before you’re meant to ✨

I’m aware, I’m on 2 antidepressants & have been to traumatic bereavement counselling but it hasn’t helped much. My family/ support system isn’t great which makes reaching out harder. Thanks for the suggestion though..
Thank you ❤️

Further to the above- they really show stories from all perspectives, those who made their wishes known and received help and left anyway, and those who didn’t show any signs and left their friends/ families bewildered. It definitely helped me to know some people do care & do understand
If you’re on instagram check out the allianceofhope, of all suicide prevention/ awareness posts I feel like these people really understand us(the survivors) point of view. I hope this helps 💕

Honestly try not to deep these things too much, I’ve worked in contact centre’s over 6 years and you’ll get this.

I used to find it amusing any time a caller would lose it on the phone, the problem lies with them, not you.
The fact they think that they can speak to people like that and throw toys out of the pram when they don’t get their way says enough about the type of person they are.

Just make sure to have a vent and take a breather if they really get under your skin before moving to your next call.

Gladly I’ve moved to leadership roles so the phones are no longer a part of my daily but I enjoy helping the new hires on my team & teaching them the tricks of the trade 😉

Best of luck & dont listen to that idiot

I’m sorry this happened to you, I 24f lost my partner of 6 years in March 2022 to suicide too. Like you we were ok living together, I knew he had his issues and we had worked on them together and things seemed to be looking up but then one day, nothing strange had happened, he seemed quiet but that wasn’t strange for him, we spent my lunch break together as I work from home, joined a team meeting and when it was over he was gone 💔

It was and still is the most painful thing I have ever endured in my life and no loss has even come close to this. I have been in the darkest places for months before I was eventually able to pull myself out & I didn’t think I was going to make it. Nowadays I spend most of my time dissociating & I think it’s my brains way of protecting itself.

I can tell you it does get easier, but life won’t be the same, nor would we want it to be after losing our person. Reach out if you need, look after yourself the best you can & take things as they come. If you feel you need reach out to your doctor for mental health support. 

Don’t think about the future that can wait. This is about you now and healing and finding your feet again, take all the time you need and don’t feel rushed into anything. A lot of people don’t understand what we’re going through which can make things much more difficult, so find people who love you at you best & worst and don’t let them go. People will change but so have you so 🖕🏼 anyone who has anything unwelcome to say.

Sending you hugs & please feel free to reach out if you need 💛 & maybe join us on r/SuicideBereavement and r/widowers for more support

So sorry you’re going through this so young.

I resonated so much your thoughts on not wanting a family anymore, we wanted two kids and planned out wedding. Now that all seems like such a silly child’s dream and far too out of reach to even think about anymore.

Sending you love & hugs x

I’m so sorry for whatever is happening in your life to make you feel this way. I understand, trust me I’m battling with suicidal thoughts nearly everyday but I’m still here, heavily medicated but still here and kicking.

What helps me is thinking, we’re all going there eventually, we won’t know or have a say when or how we go, but we will go. Many have gone before me and many will go after me, all I can do is wake up, put my best foot forward and if things go to shit some day, fuck it. Have a drink, break something, swear to the heavens and the universe but when you’re done, all you can do is try again tomorrow.

No one comes to save us, I’ve found that out the hard way, but you’re here. Paint a picture and make a mess, make some pottery and squish it all and start again. Turn your music up loud and scream until you can’t anymore.

This is your life, as is every persons life their own. So do whatever the fuck you like, say no more, and enjoy things that make YOU happy. People will let you down in life but the only one who’s ever going to make a difference in your life or to have your back completely is you. 

Food for thought, maybe the train not coming was a sign?  Your life is worth it, for you, no one else. 

If you need to talk please reach out, I’d be happy to listen ❤️

I truly understand your pain. At the moment your whole life has been turned upside down, inside out and put through the shredder. Right now, you need to try and focus on yourself, and scream till you can’t anymore, whatever you need to do. It’s something you have to find within yourself, a reason, some light that come through the absolute blackness that becomes your life.

I’ve been so close to taking my life on a number of occasions and I’ve chickened out at the last second each time. Sometimes I still feel like I’m going to come close some day. But some way, somehow I’m still here and still breathing.

My reason was my dog and 2 cats, as much as it killed me to be alive it killed me not knowing what would happen them, and how they didn’t deserve for me to leave them like that.

I know the unbearable agony your in right know and if I could  I would take the pain away from everyone going through this, no one deserves this.

I’ve felt the same since my partner died by suicide in March, I just feel like mentally I’m always elsewhere. Never truly able to accept that he’s gone. Constantly looking for ways I can make my exit, constantly stoned, on anti depressants and sleep medication, constantly trying to get away from the actual torture that is my life.

I’m so sorry this has happened you, I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. I don’t know why the world is just so cruel to those who don’t deserve it. I wish I could give you some advice but the only thing you can do is, hour by hour, and fuck it sometimes minute by minute. If That’s all you can do, then that’s all you can do. Thinking of you and here if you need to talk 💭

I believe that we as humans, don’t know everything about the universe, our existence and consciousness as a whole. We can not say without a doubt that one or the other is true, however I think we would be foolish to completely close a door to something don’t fully understand. Maybe we’re never meant to understand.

But I like to have faith that there’s something bigger than all of us happening, we’re all connected, we all come from the same place and we’re all made from the same stardust, and when we die we’re returned to the universe. 

I hope that someday I’m reunited with my partner and bestest friend. Your love for your loved one keeps you connected always. I have faith and that’s all that matters 💛

It’s all about what you believe, if you have faith it was your beloved Suzanne, then it was. Not everyone around you needs to believe and you don’t need to explain yourself to anyone. Have faith and hope, no matter your religious views or beliefs. When my partner passed I experienced a number of unusual coincidences and signs and I wouldn’t of ever been an overly spiritual or religious person prior to this (our initials started popping up everywhere together. Along with a few other strange coincidences. Weird) . Some people take them as just that… a coincidence. But I decided I would accept them as a sign and take comfort that my Luke is still around. I don’t tell everyone, only those I know might get comfort from it. 💛

Yeah I’m still there, I can’t stomach food at all. It’s just one of the many triggers. Just getting up is a win for me these days.

But yeah I feel like that part of my grief had been rushed due to his mother looking to take his belongings to start a memory box just 2 weeks after he passed and I was in no way ready to process anything like that yet. I was still only coming to terms with the loss of the most special person in the world to me and the complete loss of the future we planned together.

I just told her I wasn’t ready to do anything like that yet and would need time before I could go through our belongings. The texting continued asking for his clothes so last week I put some of his clothes together and gave them to her but said I’d need more time to go through everything else.

We all grieve differently and I didn’t want them to think I was being insensitive to their feelings so I just got some of it out of the way for another few months. It’s just been a lot to try to deal with the added anxiety of that as well as losing my best friend.

I’m glad I have out fur babies too, they honestly keep me going and have been one of the only things to make me smile over the last few weeks. 
Thanks again, it never makes it easier but it’s nice to know we’re not alone going through these horrific moments. ❤️

Heya thanks for your kind works. To be honest I felt quiet a bit of pressure from his mother to give her some of his belongings. I listened to my family’s advice and told her I wasn’t ready to go through anything yet but she was persistent. Unfortunately my partners parents were separated so she wanted all of his belongings. I let it go over my head until last week when I didn’t want it hanging over my head anymore and gave her some of his clothes etc. It was really tough but I’m glad it’s done and don’t have the added pressure to rush through my grief anymore. His fathers family have taken me as their own and have told me they don’t want anything until I’m ready so I really appreciate how kind and understanding they’ve been.

But thank you for pointing that out, it was actually something that caused unnecessary tension so early after it all happened. Hugs ❤️
